efile.text: Withholding returns are submitted electronically through the Department's online services. Businesses that issued W-2s or 1099s that contain Iowa withholding must electronically file those documents by February 15.

returns.name: Iowa W-2 / 1099 electronic filing
contents: W-2s, W-2Gs and 1099s that contain Iowa withholding are filed electronically by February 15; employees receive W-2s by the last day of January.
No filing is required if no Iowa tax was withheld.

notModelled: Iowa's filing frequency is quarterly under $6,000 of tax a year (under $500 a month), monthly from $6,000 to $120,000 ($500 to $10,000 a month), semimonthly above $120,000 (more than $10,000 a month, more than $5,000 semimonthly). Monthly filers file two monthly payments and one quarterly return each quarter; semimonthly filers six payments and one quarterly return. The stored page gives NO due dates for the payments or returns, so no deposit schedule is computed.
Iowa unemployment insurance (Iowa Workforce Development): no document read.
EasyPay Iowa and the Department's online services file layouts.
